description: Read the pinned package's registry summary in one reply: every active object and trait, keyed by name, with the registry's loaded names, any loader issues, a canonical etag and generatedAt. The default summary omits schemas, view extensions and tokens. detail full returns complete definitions; names limits the objects and traits to those names. A reply over this endpoint's 100,000-character bound is refused with its size. includeInternal adds OODS Foundry's internal objects. Use object_registry show instead for one object's composed definition, and catalog_list for components. Read-only, with no side effects: it writes nothing and changes no state.

inputSchema.description: Bulk-read recorded mappings plus live shipped and registered team traits and objects. Reports definition loader issues, including shadowed names. The default summary leaves out each trait's and object's schema, parameters, view extensions, semantics, tokens and metadata; detail full returns them, optionally only for named traits and objects. Draft preferred_terms, disambiguation_decisions and capabilities are not snapshot outputs.

detail.description: summary (default), or full definitions, best with names.

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them.

names.description: Exact trait and object names; misses go in notFound.

inputSchema.title: registry.snapshot input
